channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Anomaly President
item.description: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

item.title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
item.description: Enjoy action-packed flashy combat with incredibly satisfying combos and responsive controls! Numerous characters, each with completely unique playstyles and loads of unlockable moves & upgrades! This action roguelike sets the bar for fluid fast-paced action.

item.title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk
item.description: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is 1 second per second of advanced funkstyle. Battle rival crews and dispatch militarized police to conquer the five boroughs of New Amsterdam. Become All City.

item.title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Chaos Reign
item.description: Three years after the Clan war and the Tukayyid truce, chaos looms across the Inner Sphere. ComStar’s betrayal and a high-profile assassination shatter fragile unity. Commander Jake Mason uncovers critical Clan intel that could shift the war. New campaigns, mechs, and more await.

item.title: Super Woden: Rally Edge
item.description: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

item.title: The Ascent
item.description: The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. The mega corporation that owns you and everyone, The Ascent Group, has just collapsed. Can you survive without it?

item.title: The Ascent - Cyber Heist
item.description: Completed The Ascent but are itching for more? Cyber Heist is for you! Solo or in co-op with your friends, take on new challenging missions, explore brand new environments, fight your way against new enemies, and experience new ways of fighting using melee weapons!

item.title: Kin and Conquest
item.description: An incremental / idle action adventure game where you must battle foes, mine rocks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger in your quest to conquer the mountain and defeat the Evil Geomancer.

item.title: A Difficult Game About Climbing
item.description: This is a difficult game about climbing.
